title: cornus paniculata var. albida
intro: Cornus paniculata var. albida, commonly known as White Flowering Dogwood, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia, characterized by its showy white or pinkish flowers and red or purple berries. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to alleviate various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cornus paniculata var. albida include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various conditions. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
